description: Queue a legacy SadTalker face-animation/lipsync job from one audio source and one image source. This is a paid/high-compute legacy upstream job; poll the returned inference job token. Cookie/web-session auth is the reliable auth mode.
name: artcraft_create_face_animation

audio_media_file_token.description: Audio source as a media file token (choose exactly one audio source)

audio_media_upload_token.description: Audio source as a media upload token

dimensions.description: Output dimensions preset; upstream default twitter_landscape

image_media_file_token.description: Image source as a media file token (choose exactly one image source)

image_media_upload_token.description: Image source as a media upload token

remove_watermark.description: Only honored when the upstream plan permits watermark removal

tts_result_token.description: Audio source as a legacy TTS result token

voice_conversion_result_token.description: Audio source as a legacy voice-conversion result token
